description: Cozy and carefully decorated apartment, quiet courtyard, renovated by a decorator. Ideally located just steps from the Canal Saint-Martin, a lively and trendy area made famous by the iconic film 'Amélie' in 2001.The spaceWelcome to Our Parisian Home by Vanessa and CédricWe are Vanessa and Cédric, delighted to welcome you to our charming apartment in the heart of Paris. Having moved from central Paris when we had our first daughter in 2015, we remain deeply connected to the "City of Light" and are thrilled to share our home with you.Our aim is to provide you with a memorable and comfortable stay. We are always available to assist with any questions or requests you might have. Please don’t hesitate to reach out at any time; your satisfaction is our priority.About the ApartmentLocated on Rue des Vinaigriers, our apartment is set in a lively, multicultural neighborhood typical of northern Paris.
